summary: A store hand-writes `optionalTime(sql.NullTime) *time.Time` and `nullableString(string) sql.NullString` — two conversions guregu/null already ships and an sqlc `go_type` override already emits, so the tree now holds two spellings of one meaning. The fix deletes both: the nullable columns come out of sqlc as null.Time and null.String, and callers read .Ptr() and write null.TimeFrom. The `endedRow` beside them CARRIES a nullable value through rather than converting it and is silent in both halves. Operator directive of 2026-09-04, verbatim in go-rules.md § CS-14.
